# GitHub Copilot — DreamToosa

This repository uses **AgToosa** for agentic PM/engineering workflows.

Before non-trivial work, read `Docs/AgToosa_Agent.md` and `Docs/Master-Plan.md`.

Core commands: `/agtoosa-spec` → `/agtoosa-build` → `/agtoosa-review` → `/agtoosa-ship`. Status: `/agtoosa-status`.

Product: Python control plane for the Dream Report multi-repo routine plus Dreams memory-curation examples. See `AGENTS.md` and `README.md`.
